title: My game with support of perplexity
author: SwimmerMain2848
selftext:
I am using perplexity daily for all kinds of tasks, business and private. I love to play turn-based rpgs in my free time, and I wondered if I could have a game created the way I wanted it to be seen: \[https://siegel-der-sieben.de\](https://siegel-der-sieben.de)

I wanted it to be free as well. I know I am not a developer or a high-skilled creator but I want players to have fun.

So I started with some prompts - the first of all, if AI can develop such a game at all.

1. Can you also develop a game for me?  
2. Look up turn based rpgs, something like that: fantasy, turn-based combat, story-driven. A party of four, my hero plus three NPCs that I also control. Open world, many side quests, one main quest, interaction between the characters, etc.  
3. Don’t make the story just good or evil. Add depth, with good reasons for people’s behaviour. Let me, as the hero, also support the other side, and give me moral tasks. Add romance options and the matching content and conversations.

The suggested story was interesting and I went with it. The first graphics were - a brick playground with no feeling or atmosphere at all. I had to change this and added agents (designer) into the AI to support this. Step by step the app got a new look.

But the villages and houses, temples and dungeons were still lacking individual flair, all looked the same of empty. Quests had bugs. Images did not reflect what was told in the story. Characters moved too fast. Dungeons had only one level.

Many small things which build up or create the feeling for an rpg needed to be thought through and added.

In the meantime I needed to makes sure the progress was documented and saved, so a full or not responsive sandbox would not result in the complete loss of the game. As a browser game I did not want it to conflict with GDPR, so I chose the Hoster carefully, made sure the game does not call out to third parties.

More than 300 updates later I have the game now in a stage I am willing to share.

If you like these kind of games, you are welcome to have a look. It is a hobby and it is free at \[https://siegel-der-sieben.de\](https://siegel-der-sieben.de)

Thanks for the possibility to share this here.

Jan
